description:
A modern SVN client built with Tauri, Vue 3, and TypeScript

OrcaSVN is a modern SVN workbench that provides a graphical interface for managing Subversion repositories. Built with Tauri for native performance, Vue 3 for the frontend, and TypeScript for type safety. Features include workspace management, commit, update, diff, blame, log viewing, and more.
What's new since v0.6.0
Improvements
- Reuse recent commit messages from the commit page
- Reveal a selected workspace file in the system file manager
- Truncate long file paths in the diff sidebar and file header while keeping the full path in a tooltip
Fixes
- Keep workspace status and metadata tied to the active workspace during overlapping requests
- Decode XML entities in SVN file paths, including names containing &
- Preserve source indentation and blank lines in Blame
- Show log results in newest-first order and include the full selected end date
自 v0.6.0 以来的更新
功能改进
- 提交页面可复用最近的提交说明
- 可在系统文件管理器中定位工作区选中的文件
- 差异页面的长路径在文件列表和文件标题中截断显示，悬停可查看完整路径
问题修复
- 并发请求期间只更新当前工作区的状态和元数据
- 正确解析包含 & 等 XML 特殊字符的 SVN 文件路径
- Blame 保留源码缩进和空行
- 日志按新到旧显示，并包含所选结束日期的全部记录
